records.source: WHY THE LIST HAS FIVE HEADINGS RATHER THAN A BOOLEAN. It used to be one list with "show unvetted community uploads" beside it -- a control that could fold away exactly one of the catalogue's five origins. With ten models trained here, four stock Cellpose-SAM backbones, bioimage.io's collection, the Cellpose 3 backend's own four and a shared catalogue, a user who wanted the ten and not the rest had no way to say so. :class:`SourceStrip` is the five origins as five clickable names, each one blue when its rows are on screen and muted when they are folded away, remembered between openings. The warning the boolean carried is unchanged and still arrives before the first unvetted row does -- see :meth:`ModelZooPicker._may_show_source`.

This saves the picture, at the resolution it was rendered at rather than the size it happens to be shown at, into a file of the user's choosing.
records.translation: 界面上的图像往往正是有人一小时后想放进幻灯片里的东西，而过去的办法是对窗口截图，分辨率受限于窗口，还带着周围的界面元素。本功能以图像渲染时的分辨率（而不是它碰巧显示的尺寸）将“图像本身”保存到用户选择的文件中。

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.picture_export#3
records.source: TWO FORMATS, AND THE PDF IS NOT A PNG WITH A DIFFERENT EXTENSION. A raster dropped into a PDF satisfies the file name and nothing else; a figure panel is a page, and a page has a size in millimetres. :func:`save_picture` gives the PDF a page the image's own shape and tells the writer the resolution Preferences carries, so the picture lands at the size it was measured at and prints at that resolution.
records.context: Two formats, and the PDF is not a PNG with a different extension. A raster dropped into a PDF satisfies the file name and nothing else; a figure panel is a page, and a page has a size in millimetres. :func:`save_picture` gives the PDF a page the image's own shape and tells the writer the resolution Preferences carries, so the picture lands at the size it was measured at and prints at that resolution.
